clue.text: Stationed in east so push for strong drink

parts.note: E is the compass abbreviation for east

indicators.note: something stationed in a place is set down inside it, so the push word goes within the letters of east and so

parts.note: taken as written
to push is to press

explanation.surface: An odd instruction about someone posted out east who pushes for a stiff drink.
explanation.definitionFit: This concentrated Italian coffee is famously strong, a short black shot.

clue.text: Son having slight temperature avoids paella flavouring

indicators.note: a word that avoids something steers clear of it, so the temperature letter is left out of the slight

parts.note: a slight, as a noun, is an insult or affront

explanation.surface: A son with a mild fever skips the paella; a kitchen-table domestic scene.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Slight' looks like an adjective for the temperature but it is the noun AFFRONT, which loses its T.
explanation.definitionFit: Saffron is the costly spice that gives Spanish paella its yellow colour and flavour.

clue.text: Approximate guide in digital governance?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a rough practical method rather than an exact one
second meaning, cryptic: rule by the thumb, which is a digit of the hand

explanation.walkthrough: 'Digital' suggests computers, but here it means to do with the fingers and thumbs, which are digits.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom for a rough method based on experience rather than precise measurement.

clue.text: Alexander has opinion about nude seen here and there

indicators.note: one thing about another goes round it, so the opinion word surrounds the letters from nude

parts.note: to have your say is to give your opinion

indicators.note: only letters dotted here and there are shown, so take alternate letters of nude

explanation.surface: A man called Alexander gives his view on a nude glimpsed in patches.
explanation.walkthrough: Sandy is the usual Scottish pet form of Alexander, so the name, not a beach, is defined.
explanation.definitionFit: Sandy is a common pet form of the given name, especially in Scotland.

clue.text: Unusual action needed to consume cold tongue

indicators.note: to consume something is to take it in, so the cold letter goes inside the rearranged word
something unusual is out of its normal order, so the letters of action are rearranged

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: Strange measures are needed to eat a chilled ox tongue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tongue' looks like food here, but it means a language. Rearrange ACTION and put C inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Occitan is the Romance language of southern France, and tongue is a common word for a language.

clue.text: Shot where force breaches European citadel

indicators.note: an army that breaches a wall gets inside it, so the force letter enters the other letters

parts.note: a citadel is a fortress or fort
F is the physics abbreviation for force

explanation.surface: A military scene in which an army storms a European fortress.
explanation.definitionFit: To have a shot at something is to make an attempt, an effort.

clue.text: Enhance glowing piece about French king with duke

indicators.note: one thing about others goes round them, so the glowing piece surrounds the king and duke

parts.note: an ember is a glowing piece of coal or wood
roi is French for king

explanation.surface: A shining heirloom set with images of a French king and a duke is made finer.
explanation.definitionFit: To embroider a story is to embellish it with extra detail, improving it.

clue.text: Maybe bass part loud one needed at the start

parts.note: F is forte, the musical direction for loud
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: only what stands at the start of the word needed is used, its first letter

explanation.surface: A musician's note that a bass line needs a loud opening.
explanation.walkthrough: The musical surface misleads: bass is the fish, which has a fin.
explanation.definitionFit: A bass is a fish, and a fin is one of its body parts; 'maybe' marks the example.

clue.text: Building over frozen soil sees river rising

indicators.note: in a down clue a thing rising moves upwards, so the river letter climbs to the top of the word

parts.note: O is the cricket abbreviation for over
tundra is the frozen treeless land of the Arctic

explanation.surface: A building put up over permafrost sees a river rise around it.
explanation.walkthrough: Write O then TUNDRA; the R of TUNDRA rises to the top of this down answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotunda is a round building, usually topped with a dome.

clue.text: Senior ministers in queue perhaps store hard copies here?

parts.note: people filing are moving in a line, as in a queue
the cabinet is the group of senior government ministers

explanation.surface: Top politicians lining up, perhaps to stash paper documents somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the definition describes the furniture by what it does rather than naming it.
explanation.definitionFit: Offices keep paper documents in this tall drawered piece of furniture.

clue.text: Religious house seen in earlier years

parts.note: prior means earlier
Y is the abbreviation for year or years

explanation.surface: A religious building seen here in earlier times.
explanation.definitionFit: A priory is a monastery or convent run by a prior or prioress.

clue.text: Timbre enthralling traveller born to find instrument

indicators.note: something enthralling another holds it captive within, so the timbre word surrounds the rest

parts.note: timbre is the tone of a sound
Rom is a member of the Roma, the travelling people

explanation.surface: A sound that enchants a born wanderer helps them find a musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: The trombone is a brass instrument with a slide.

clue.text: Nan having success as one bringing home the bacon

parts.note: nan is a kind of Indian bread
a winner is a success

explanation.surface: Granny's triumph makes her the family earner.
explanation.walkthrough: Nan reads as a grandmother, but it is naan, the flatbread.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring home the bacon is an idiom for earning the household's living.

clue.text: Relaxed as not spotted snatching rupees

indicators.note: one who snatches something grabs and holds it, so the rupees letter is taken inside

parts.note: unstained means free of spots or marks
R is the abbreviation for rupee or rupees

explanation.surface: A pickpocket stays calm, unnoticed while grabbing some rupees.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not spotted' suggests unseen, but it means without stains.
explanation.definitionFit: Unstrained means not forced or tense, so easy and natural in manner.

clue.text: Grown-up with one leg to accept answer as flattery

indicators.note: to accept something is to take it in, so the answer letter goes inside the other pieces

parts.note: an adult is a grown-up
I is the Roman numeral for one
on is the leg side in cricket

explanation.surface: An adult with one leg takes a compliment as flattery.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the leg side of the field is also called the on side, so leg gives ON.
explanation.definitionFit: Adulation is excessive admiration or praise, much like flattery.

clue.text: Exploit recalled framing a wronged brother

indicators.note: a frame goes round a picture, so the reversed word surrounds a
something recalled is called back, so the exploit word is read backwards

parts.note: to exploit is to use

explanation.surface: Remembered exploitation sets up a brother who was badly treated.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, Esau was cheated of his birthright and blessing by his twin Jacob.

clue.text: Fellows applied to university, getting course list

parts.note: fellows are men

explanation.surface: Academics apply to a university and receive a list of courses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Course list' suggests a university syllabus; the courses are those of a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A menu lists the dishes, or courses, of a meal.

clue.text: Island in unsettled US area, or continental one?

indicators.note: one letter in the others goes inside them, so the island letter sits within the rearranged letters
unsettled letters are disturbed from their order, so US and area are rearranged

explanation.surface: Is the island in a troubled American region, or on a continent?
explanation.definitionFit: Eurasia is the combined landmass of Europe and Asia, a continent.

clue.text: Guard, in bed, suffering complete

indicators.note: a suffering patient is in a bad way, so the letters are put out of order

explanation.surface: A guard lies ill in bed, his suffering total.
explanation.definitionFit: An unabridged book is the full text, not shortened.

clue.text: Aloe vera treated missing volume in sunken spots

indicators.note: treated means processed, so the letters of aloe vera are reworked
something missing is not there, so the volume letter is left out

explanation.surface: A skin cream is applied to blemishes, but the bottle is short.
explanation.definitionFit: Areolae are small spaces or pits, here hollow spots; the plural of areola.

clue.text: Choice ultimately mine to assume the nickname

indicators.note: what comes ultimately is the last letter of choice
to assume something is to take it on, so mine takes the word the inside it

parts.note: a pit is a coal mine

explanation.surface: A miner's eventual choice of nickname.
explanation.definitionFit: An epithet is a descriptive name or byname given to someone.

clue.text: Cheat to secure point in street game?

parts.note: to crib is to cheat by copying
to bag something is to secure it
E is east, a compass point

explanation.surface: A con artist cheats to win a point in a street game.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark covers a loose definition: crib is street slang for home, so this is the game of the crib.
explanation.definitionFit: Cribbage is a card game scored on a pegboard, with a hand called the crib.

clue.text: Goddess makes appearance following credit crunch

indicators.note: one thing following another comes after it, so the goddess goes after the credit letters

parts.note: CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit
Isis is the Egyptian goddess

explanation.surface: A divinity appears in the wake of a credit crunch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Credit crunch' reads as one phrase, but crunch alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: When it comes to the crunch means at the decisive moment, a critical point or emergency.

clue.text: Crumbs American soldier gives dog

parts.note: crumbs! and cor! are both British exclamations of surprise
GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A US soldier feeds crumbs to a dog.
explanation.walkthrough: Crumbs looks like food scraps, but it is an exclamation of surprise, as is cor.
explanation.definitionFit: The corgi is a short-legged Welsh breed, famous as the Queen's pet.

clue.text: Important: arm this police unit

parts.note: special means important or distinctive
a branch is an arm of an organisation

explanation.surface: A brisk order: it is vital to give weapons to this police squad.
explanation.walkthrough: Arm reads as a verb about weapons, but it is the noun for a division. Special Branch is the UK police unit for national security.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the name of the British police department dealing with political security.

clue.text: Bird Madagascan primate skinned

indicators.note: a thing skinned loses its outer layer, so the first and last letters go

parts.note: the lemur is a primate found only in Madagascar

explanation.surface: A bird and a Madagascan primate that has been skinned; a grim zoological scene.
explanation.definitionFit: The emu is a large flightless Australian bird.

clue.text: When retired go round world

indicators.note: something retired has gone back, so the when word is read backwards

parts.note: as means when, as in 'as I left'
to turn is to go round

explanation.surface: A retiree goes on a trip around the world.
explanation.definitionFit: Saturn is a planet, and world is a poetic name for a planet.

clue.text: Leave country singer regularly housed by English couple

indicators.note: something housed by another lives inside it, so the letters from singer go within couple

parts.note: to couple is to mate

indicators.note: taking letters at regular intervals, every other letter of singer

explanation.surface: A singer is put up by an English couple before heading abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Country singer' suggests a musical genre; country belongs to the definition, and singer gives up alternate letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To emigrate is to leave one's homeland to settle abroad.
